description: Genotypes for PLINK 2: the first 600 biallelic variants of chromosome 21 of the 1000 Genomes Project's Phase 3 release for its 2,504 people (the test file of PLINK 2 itself, unchanged), with a list of 48 of the sample IDs and synthetic weights for --score; and synthetic genotypes, phenotypes and covariates of 603 invented samples for association tests (--glm). From the PLINK 2 test data of the genomics-wasm project.
data citation (1000 Genomes): The 1000 Genomes Project Consortium (2015) A global reference for human genetic variation. Nature 526: 68–74. doi:10.1038/nature15393 – data reuse: https://www.internationalgenome.org/IGSR_disclaimer/ (consulted by genomics-wasm on 13 October 2026; see DATA_REUSE.md there)

keep48.samples.txt.transformation: First 48 unchanged sample identifiers, in source order; an explicit bounded test subset.

synthetic_scores.tsv.transformation: Choose 20 variants with greatest ALT allele count, source order breaks ties. Assign arbitrary coefficient ((rank % 7)-3)/8. Synthetic software-test coefficients, not measured effects or a clinical score.

synthetic_glm.vcf.transformation: Synthetic adaptation: retain upstream 603 samples, 30 variants and exact alternating missingness formula. Replace PLINK --dummy and implementation-dependent awk rand with the explicit upstream LCG (seed 3), common-allele frequencies 0.12+0.36*U and two Bernoulli allele draws per genotype.

synthetic_phenotypes.tsv.transformation: BINARY uses upstream 0.4 case probability, LCG seed 11 replacing awk rand. QUANT is independent 4*U-2 (seed19). FIRTH is intentionally 2 for v1 ALT carriers, 1 otherwise to force separation. All labels synthetic; no biological association claim.

synthetic_covariates.tsv.transformation: Upstream two-covariate formulas and seed 7, with explicit LCG replacing awk rand; entirely synthetic.
